part: ch. 112 — what the prophets showed in their flesh
source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 112 — public domain. Geʿez text as in Ran HaCohen's Unicode edition of Bezold (tau.ac.il/~hacohen/KN, from Michal Jerabek's 1995 digitization), archived and checked against Bezold's printed page. Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Chapter 112 argues that the patriarchs and prophets showed the Trinity and the resurrection in their own lives. Isaac's binding and the lamb from heaven, Jacob's staff (read as Mary and as the cross), and Moses' staff and two sons are types of Christ. God's words to Moses, 'God of Abraham, of Isaac, of Jacob', are assigned to Father, Son and Spirit (Exodus 3:6, Matthew 22:32). Jonah, Daniel and Joseph then foreshadow burial and rising. The patriarchs' insistence on burial in the family tomb (Abraham, Jacob, Joseph) is read as hope of resurrection. The Geʿez has several source slips, kept as printed and noted (ፈለ ሰ ሙሴ, ብእሲ ቱ, ፲ወ፪ደቂቀ, ዛህገር, and the unusual -ዲ in ወልዲ and ዘመዲ). A few words I could not settle (አጥረየ, ተረግዘ, ተበዊሖ, አብድንተ, አያተ) are marked (?). Dillmann's lexicon was not open for this draft.

sentences.i: Chapter 112: Concerning what the prophets showed in their own flesh
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፲፪ is the numeral 112 (፻ hundred, ፲ ten, ፪ two). በእንተ 'concerning' governs a ዘ- clause: ዘ- 'that which' + አርአዩ, the perfect 3rd plural of አርአየ 'show' (causative of ርእየ 'see'); ነቢያት 'prophets' (broken plural of ነቢይ) is the subject, placed after the verb. በሥጋሆሙ is በ- 'in' + ሥጋ 'flesh, body' + -ሆሙ 'their'. The chapter reads the lives of patriarchs and prophets (Isaac, Jacob, Moses, Jonah, Daniel, Joseph) as foreshadowings of Christ, the Trinity and the resurrection. 'In their flesh' I take as 'in their own persons and bodies'.

sentences.l: He-obeyed Isaac to-father-his, and-said: 'Bind-me!' and-he-was-offered while not he-dies; he-ransomed-him with-lamb which-came-down from-heavens;
sentences.i: Isaac obeyed his father and said, 'Bind me.' And he was offered up while he did not die; he was ransomed with a lamb that came down from heaven;
sentences.n: The binding of Isaac (Genesis 22). ተአዘዘ is the ተ- stem of አዘዘ 'command', so 'obey', with ለ- 'to' marking the one obeyed (ለአቡሁ: አብ 'father' + -ሁ 'his', giving አቡሁ). ዕቅደኒ is the imperative of ዐቀደ 'bind' (?; unchecked) with -ኒ 'me'. ወተሦዐ: ተሦዐ 'was sacrificed' (passive of ሠዋዐ 'sacrifice', contracted (?)); እንዘ + imperfect (ኢይመውት) = 'while he does not die'. ተቤዘዎ is the perfect 3rd masculine singular of ተቤዘወ 'ransom, redeem' (a ተ- verb with active sense) with -ዎ 'him': 'he ransomed him'. The subject is not stated (God, or the lamb (?)), so the English is given as a passive. በበግዕ 'with a lamb' (በግዕ is lamb or sheep; Genesis has a ram); ዘወረደ እምሰማያት 'which came down from heaven' is the author's addition, not in Genesis. The sentence is a ፤-unit: it is completed by the next, 'and likewise the Son of God...'.

sentences.l: And-likewise son-of God obedient to-father-his became until to-death, and-was-bound through-love-of man, and-was-nailed, and-was-pierced(?), and-became ransom-our son-of God, and-divinity-his not-suffered; and-as Jacob son-his migrated land-of Laban, city-of brother-of mother-his, with staff-his alone, and-there made much cattle and-acquired(?) pure and-impure, and-begot 12 sons, and-revealed baptism, and-returned into country-his where he-took blessing from Isaac father-his, and-likewise Lord-our Christ came-down from-heavens alone, word-of divinity;
sentences.i: In the same way the Son of God became obedient to his Father even unto death. Out of love for mankind he was bound, nailed, and pierced(?), and he became our ransom, the Son of God; and his divinity did not suffer. And as Jacob, Isaac's son, journeyed to the land of Laban, the city of his mother's brother, with only his staff, and there gained many flocks and acquired(?) both clean and unclean beasts, and begot twelve sons, and revealed baptism, and returned to his own country, where he had received a blessing from Isaac his father, so too our Lord Christ came down from heaven alone, the Word of divinity;
sentences.n: One comparison, 60 words with no ፤ to cut at: Christ, then Jacob, closed by 'and likewise' (ወከማሁ). 'Obedient unto death' echoes Philippians 2:8. ተአዛዜ is the accusative predicate of ኮነ. ወተአስረ 'was bound' (ተ- passive of አሰረ). ወተቀነወ: 'was nailed', the house rendering (cf. ቅንዋት 'nails'), which fits the series 'bound, nailed, pierced'. ወተረግዘ: 'was pierced, struck' (?); the root is uncertain and Dillmann was not open. ወኮነ ቤዛነ ወልደ እግዚአብሔር: ቤዛ 'ransom' + -ነ 'our'; 'Son of God' is repeated after the predicate. ኢሐመ 'did not suffer' (ሐመ 'be ill, suffer'). In ወበከመ ያዕቆብ ወልዲ the printed -ዲ is not a regular suffix: 'my' would be -የ (ወልድየ), which does not fit, and 3ms 'his' after a consonant is -ሁ > -ዱ, so I take -ዲ as the digitized text's variant of -ዱ, 'his son' (Isaac's son Jacob), as the house entry has (?); the same form recurs in ዘመዲ, ወውሉዲ and ወልዲ (Joseph) in units 12-15. ፈለሰ 'migrated'; ምድረ ላባ 'the land of Laban', ሀገረ እኅወ እሙ 'city of the brother of his mother' (እኁ 'brother' in the construct state (as ሀገረ is); እሙ is እም 'mother' + -ሁ). ወአጥረየ: from ጥሪት 'property, wealth'? so 'gained as possession' (?); 'gathered' would suit equally; it recurs in the next unit. ፲ወ፪ደቂቀ is printed with no space: ፲ወ፪ is 12 and ደቂቀ 'sons' (plural of ወልድ in the accusative); a source slip, kept. ወከሠተ ጥምቀተ 'and revealed baptism': the author does not say how; Jacob's crossing of the Jordan (Genesis 32:10) may be meant (?). ኀበ ነሥአ በረከተ 'where he took a blessing' (Genesis 27).

sentences.i: As for the staff of Jacob, with which he pastured his sheep, she is our Lady Mary, our saviour; and it is also interpreted as the wood of the cross, on which he was hung and saved his flock, and acquired(?) us, who come from the Jews, the pagans and the nations;
sentences.n: Typology again: the staff is read two ways. ወበትረ is ወ- 'and' + በትር 'staff' in construct before ያዕቆብ; -ሰ gives 'as for'. በዘ ይሬዒ is በ- 'with' + ዘ 'that which' + ይሬዒ 'he pastures' (imperfect of ርዕየ 'tend'); አባግዒሁ is አባግዕ, plural of በግዕ 'sheep', + -ሁ. ይእቲ 'she (is)' acts as the copula; the staff is feminine, so Mary is 'she'. መድኀኒትነ is the feminine of መድኀኒ 'saviour' + -ነ 'our' (the glossary's earlier entry has 'our salvation', which is the alternative reading (?)). ትተረጐም is the 3rd feminine singular imperfect of the passive of ተርጐመ 'interpret' (a four-letter verb, so the ተ- is part of its base form), 'she/it is interpreted'. እንተ ባቲ is 'which on her', i.e. 'on which' (እንተ is the feminine relative; ባቲ is በ- 'on, in' + the 3rd feminine singular suffix, 'on her'). ተሰቂሎ is the converb of ተሰቅለ 'be hung, crucified'. መርዔቶ 'his flock' (መርዔት 'flock, pasture' + -ሁ). ወአጥረየነ 'gained us' (?), as in the last unit. አረሚ 'pagan, gentile'; አሕዛብ 'nations'; እምአይሁድ 'from the Jews' (እም- 'from').

sentences.i: And he chose for himself twelve apostles, and they brought about belief(?) throughout the earth and on their journeys(?); and he ascended to the heavens, to his Father. And as Moses journeyed to the land of Midian and there spoke with God, and came to know and learned the faith in the resurrection of the dead, held by his fathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and with that same staff was empowered(?) to work wonders, and begot two sons, so this too shows plainly that through the Trinity we are saved.
sentences.n: 47 words with no ፤, so it stays whole. Source slip: ፈለ ፡ ሰ ፡ ሙሴ is printed with ፈለሰ 'migrated' split in two; kept as printed. ወኀረየ ሎቱ: ኀረየ 'choose', ሎቱ 'for himself' (ለ- + -ሁ); ሐዋርያተ 'apostles'. ወአእመኑ: perfect 3rd plural; it is either አእመነ 'cause to believe' (the apostles spread belief) or 'they believed', subject not stated (?). ወበሓውርት: ሓውርት read as ሐውርት 'journeys, goings' (?). ብሔረ ምድያም 'the land of Midian' (Exodus 2). ተናጊሮ 'speaking with' (converb of ተናገረ), አእሚሮ 'knowing' (converb of አእመረ), ተምሂሮ 'having learned' (converb of ተምህረ). አሚነ I take as the accusative of a noun 'faith' (?) (it could also be a converb 'believing', continuing the series ተናጊሮ, አእሚሮ, ተምሂሮ (?)), governing ዘበትንሣኤ ምዉታን 'which is in the resurrection of the dead' (ትንሣኤ 'rising' in construct with ምዉታን 'the dead'). ተበዊሖ: the root is unclear to me; 'empowered' is a guess from context (?). ከመ ይግበር ተኣምረ 'to work wonders' (the staff signs of Exodus 4). The two sons are Moses' (Exodus 18:3-4), set against Jacob's twelve; the author draws the number 'two' and 'twelve' into a Trinitarian argument that he does not fully spell out. ዝኒ is ዝ 'this' + -ኒ 'too'. ንድኅን 'we are saved' (imperfect of ድኅነ).

sentences.n: Cut from the next at a ፤ (the whole quotation is 53 words). The quotation is Exodus 3:6 (God to Moses at the bush), read with Matthew 22:32, where Jesus argues from it for the resurrection. The author assigns each name to a person of the Trinity: ዘንተ ዘአብ 'this [is] of the Father' (ዘ- of belonging, with the copula omitted). አፉሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his mouth, of God' = 'the mouth of God' (the -ሁ + ለ- genitive). አምላከ is the accusative-form 'God' in construct (the predicate of an unspoken 'I am').

sentences.n: Continues the quotation, Matthew 22:32. ኢኮንኩ 'I am not' (ኮነ with the 1st singular -ኩ). ምዉታን 'the dead' and ሕያዋን 'the living' are plural adjectives; በኀቤሁ 'with him'. ወበዝንቱኬ 'and by this indeed' (-ኬ is emphatic). ተዐውቀ 'was made known' (passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?), as in the house entry). ተገንዘ: ገንዘ is 'wrap a corpse for burial', so 'was shrouded' (?), perhaps loosely 'was swallowed'. ዐንበሪ 'whale, sea monster'. Jonah is the type of the burial in the next unit.

sentences.i: And Daniel too was put into the lions' pit, and they sealed it with their seals, and he rose without their devouring him; and so our Lord also was put into the tomb, and the Jews sealed him with their seals, thinking that they were sealing the rising of the sun so that it would not shine. O fools, corrupt(?) and filthy, blind and dull(?), do you say that the spirit of life(?) will not come and go forth?
sentences.n: Daniel 6:17 (the stone and the seals) set beside Matthew 27:66 (the guard and the seal on the tomb). ወዳንኤልኒ is ወ- 'and' + ዳንኤል + -ኒ 'too'; ተወድየ 'was put' (passive of ወደየ); ግበ አናብስት 'pit of lions' (construct). ኀተምዋ 'they sealed it' (the pit, feminine -ዋ); ኀተምዎ 'they sealed him' (-ዎ). ዘእንበለ ይብልዕዎ 'without their eating him'. እንዘ ይመስሎሙ 'while it seemed to them'; ዘየኀትሙ 'that they were sealing', ዘ as a conjunction (?). ምሥራቀ ፀሐይ 'the rising of the sun' (መሥራቅ). Vocatives after ኦ: አብዳን 'fools', ሕቡላን (ሕቡል, 'corrupt, perverse' (?)), ፅሩፋን (ጽሩፍ 'foul, defiled'), ዕውራን 'blind', ዕንቡዛን (?, 'dull, stupid' guessed from the series). ትብሉኑ 'do you say?' (-ኑ is the question particle). መንፈሰ ሕይወት 'spirit of life'; ኢይምጻእ ወኢይጻእ are two negated subjunctives, 'come' (መጽአ) and 'go out' (ወጽአ). መንፈሰ ሕይወት is accusative in form, so it is hardly the subject of these 3rd masculine singular verbs; it may be an accusative of state (Christ coming and going out 'as a spirit of life') (?). I give the plainer 'the spirit of life' as subject.

sentences.i: Joseph was sold by the hand of his brothers, and our Lord was sold by the hand of Judas; and where he was sold, he saved his brothers from famine; and Christ too saved us who believed in him, and made us his heirs and his brothers. And as Joseph gave his kinsmen an inheritance in the land of Goshen, so he will give his righteous ones a dwelling, a land of eternal inheritance.
sentences.n: Joseph (Genesis 37, 41-47) as a type of Christ. ተሠይጠ 'was sold' (passive of ሠየጠ). በእደ 'by the hand of' (እድ 'hand'). ይሁዳ is written the same for Judah, who proposed selling Joseph (Genesis 37:26-27), and Judas Iscariot; here it clearly means Judas. ወበኀበ: በኀበ 'where, at the place where'. አድኀኖሙ ለአኀዊሁ: the pronoun -ሙ is doubled by ለአኀዊሁ 'them, his brothers'. ረኃብ 'famine'. ክርስቶስኒ: -ኒ 'too'. ወረሰየነ መዋርስቲሁ: ረሰየ 'make, set' takes two accusatives, 'made us his heirs' (መዋርስት 'heirs'; cf. Romans 8:17). ወህቦሙ 'gave them' (ወሀበ; the ወ is the verb's own first root letter, not 'and', and the printed ህ stands for ሀ); ርስተ 'inheritance'. ጌሠም 'Goshen' (the Septuagint form Gesem; Genesis 45:10, 47:27). ይሁቦሙ 'he will give them' (imperfect). ማኅደረ 'dwelling'. ዘለዓለም 'eternal' (ዘ- + ለዓለም 'for ever').

sentences.i: And again, concerning the resurrection of the dead, I will give you a sign, so that you may know, understand and examine closely, through the clear showing(?) of its word. Understand(?) this: Abraham, when he came into the land of inheritance, first bought a tomb, where he might gather the bodies(?) of his kinsfolk, his children and his wife, so that he might share the rising with them. They buried Sarah his wife there, and he himself was also buried there;
sentences.n: Genesis 23 (Abraham buys the cave at Machpelah and buries Sarah) and 25:9-10. አነ እሁበከ: 'I will give you' (imperfect of ወሀበ with -ከ); the pronoun አነ is stressed. ትእምርተ 'sign'. ከመ ታእምር ወትለቡ ወትጠይቅ are three subjunctives, 'that you know, understand, examine' (አእመረ, ለበወ (?), ጠየቀ). In በአምርሕተ ነገሩ the noun አምርሕት is unknown to me; I take it as 'clear showing' from ምርሐ (?). ትሌቡ is printed with a different vowel from ወትለቡ and has no clear function; I take it as a second 'you understand' (?). አቅደመ 'first' (an adverbial use of አቅደመ 'precede') with ተሣይጦ 'buying' (converb of ተሣየጠ). ያስተጋብእ 'he gathers' (አስተጋብአ 'gather', the causative of ተጋብአ 'assemble'); አብድንተ I read as a plural 'bodies, corpses' (?). ወውሉዲ is as printed; ውሉድ 'children' is the likely word, the final -ዲ again as in ወልዲ (see unit 3). ይኅበር 'be joined' (ኀበረ). ተንሥኦ 'rising'. ወቀበርዋ ህየ ለሳራ: 'they buried her there, Sarah'; -ዋ is doubled by ለሳራ. ለሊሁ 'he himself'.

And Isaac too was buried with Rebecca his wife; and after this Jacob went down to the land of Egypt with seventy-seven souls, because of the famine and because of Joseph his son, until they multiplied, and their number was six hundred thousand foot-soldiers(?) fit for battle, apart from women and children;
sentences.n: Source slip: ብእሲ ፡ ቱ is printed for ብእሲቱ 'his wife' (ብእሲት + -ሁ); kept as printed. እስመ ነቢይ ውእቱ: 'for prophet he (is)', ውእቱ the copula; አእሚሮ 'knowing'. ዘመዲ: ዘመድ 'kinsman' with the odd -ዲ (see ወልዲ, unit 3). ተቀብሩ is the plural 'they were buried', with ይስሐቅ ምስለ ርብቃ 'Isaac with Rebecca' (Genesis 49:31). ምስለ ፸ ፡ ወ፯ ፡ ነፍስ: ፸ is 70 and ፯ is 7, so 77 souls; Hebrew Genesis 46:27 says 70 and the Septuagint 75, so the author's number is his own or from his copy (?). በእንተ ረኃብ 'because of famine'. እስከ በዝኀ 'until it/they multiplied'. ኆልቆሙ 'their number'; ፷፼ is 60 x 10,000 = 600,000, as Exodus 12:37. The sum is certain; the spoken Geʿez words in the glossary are my reconstruction (?). አጋር I read as 'on foot' (?) from that verse. ድልዋን 'ready, fit'. ወደቅ 'and little ones' (children).

sentences.n: Genesis 47:29-31 and 49:29-32. ርሥእ 'old age'. ወይቤሎ ለዮሴፍ: 'and he said to him, to Joseph' (-ሎ doubled by ለዮሴፍ). አምሕሎ ኣምሕለከ: ኣምሕለከ is 'I make you swear' (1st singular imperfect of the causative አምሐለ + -ከ 'you'; the 4th-order ኣ is the causative prefix, as printed); the preceding አምሕሎ is the verbal noun 'oath' as a cognate accusative, as in the house entry: 'with an oath I adjure you'. በሕይወተ 'by the life of'; አበውየ 'my fathers' (አበው, plural of አብ + -የ); አምላኪየ 'my God' (-የ after a consonant). ሐዳሲሃ ለሕይወትየ: ሐዳሲ 'renewer' + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለሕይወትየ 'of my life' (the ለ- genitive with a pronoun in advance). ከመ ኢትቅብረኒ 'that you not bury me' (-ኒ 'me'). ዛህገር is ዛ 'this' + ሀገር 'land' printed as one word. ዘእንበለ ውስተ 'except in'. ዓዲ 'still, yet'.

sentences.i: Take note, then, of this matter: Joseph his son carried Israel and buried him in the tomb of his fathers, for he stood in awe of the oath Jacob had made him swear.
sentences.n: Genesis 50:1-13. The author turns the burial into an argument that the patriarchs expected resurrection. ዑቅኬ is, I take it, an imperative 'take heed' (the form is irregular (?)) with -ኬ 'then'; በዝ አያተ ነገር: በዝ 'in this'; አያተ is obscure to me (perhaps 'sights, aspects'), so I render only 'this matter' (ነገር) and leave አያተ out (?). ወጾሮ 'and he carried him' (ጾረ + -ሁ). እስራኤል is Jacob's other name. መሐላሁ 'his oath'; ዘአምሐሎ 'which he made him swear' (-ሎ 'him'). ፈርሀ 'feared, stood in awe of'.

sentences.i: And again, when Joseph fell ill in Egypt, he called his brothers and his sons and made them swear that they would not leave his bones in the land of Egypt, but that, 'When God visits you, take them with you, and gather up my bones into the tomb of my fathers.'
sentences.n: Genesis 50:24-25 (and Exodus 13:19). ሐመ 'fell ill' (see ኢሐመ 'did not suffer' above). ጸውዖሙ 'he called them' (ጸውዐ + -ሙ), ለአኀዊሁ ወለደቂቁ 'his brothers and his sons'. ከመ ኢይኅድጉ 'that they not leave'. ሶበ ሐወጸክሙ 'when he visits you' (ሐወጸ 'visit'; -ክሙ 'you', plural). ንሥኡ and ደምሩ are plural imperatives, 'take' and 'gather up'; አዕፅምትየ 'my bones' (አዕፅምት + -የ). The oath passes from reported speech (ከመ ኢይኅድጉ, third person) to direct speech (አዕፅምትየ 'my bones') without a marker. The closing ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the printed end mark of the part, kept with this last unit.

glossary.ባሕቲታ: ባሕቲት — she alone (ባሕቲት 'alone' + -ኣ '3fs her') · 'alone' as a fixed adverbial form, said of Christ (ወረደ ባሕቲታ 'came down alone') as well as of the staff
glossary.ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
glossary.ብእሲ: ብእሲ — man, husband (noun) · also the first part of ብእሲቱ 'his wife', split by a stray wordspace (ብእሲ ፡ ቱ); source slip
glossary.ብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — his wife (noun + -u 'his') · 'his wife' with the owner added after it (ብእሲቱ እኁሁ 'his wife, his brother's'; not the construct ብእሲተ)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
glossary.ቦአ: ቦአ — he entered (3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ተሠይጠ: ተሠይጠ — he was sold (3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ሠየጠ 'sell')
glossary.ተሣይጦ: ተሣየጠ — to buy, buying (verbal noun of ተሣየጠ, 'buy from')
glossary.ተሰቂሎ: ተሰቅለ — having been hanged, hanged (converb, 3ms, passive ተ-stem of ሰቀለ)
glossary.ተቀብረ: ቀበረ — he/it was buried (3ms perfect, Gt passive, q-b-r)
glossary.ተቀብሩ: ተቀብረ — they were buried (3mp perfect, passive tä-stem of ቀበረ; the verb is plural because Isaac and Rebecca are buried together, ይስሐቅ ምስለ ርብቃ 'Isaac with Rebecca')
glossary.ተበዊሖ: ተበዊሖ (?) — empowered (?) (converb; root unclear, sense guessed from context)
glossary.ተቤዘዎ: ተቤዘወ — he ransomed him, i.e. he was ransomed (3ms perfect, active-sense tä-verb, + -ዎ '3ms him'; subject unstated)
glossary.ተናጊሮ: ተናገረ — speaking with, conversing (converb, 3ms, tä-stem of ነገረ 'speak')
glossary.ተንሥኦ: ተንሥኦ — rising (verbal noun of ተንሥአ 'arise', accusative)
glossary.ተአዘዘ: ተአዘዘ — he was commanded (3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of አዘዘ 'command') · 'he obeyed' (ተአዘዘ ይስሐቅ ለአቡሁ 'Isaac obeyed his father', ch. 112; the one obeyed is marked with ለ-)
glossary.ተአዛዜ: ተአዛዚ — obedient (adjective, accusative, predicate of ኮነ; from ተአዘዘ 'obey')
glossary.ተወድየ: ተወድየ — he was put, placed (3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ወደየ 'put')
glossary.ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
glossary.ተገንዘ: ገነዘ (?) — he was wrapped for burial (?) (3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ገነዘ)
glossary.ቱ: እሙንቱ — (?) final syllable of እሙንቱ 'they are' split off by the wordspace, so እሙን ቱ ≈ 'they are' (?); not a separate word · in ch. 111 (መኑ ውእ ቱ ዝንቱ) the end of ውእቱ 'he, it is', split off by the printed wordspace (ውእ ፡ ቱ); not a word of its own · also the final -ቱ of ብእሲቱ 'his wife' (ብእሲ ፡ ቱ), split off by the printed wordspace; not a word
glossary.ታእምር: አእመረ — that you may know (2ms subjunctive)
glossary.ትሌቡ: ለበወ (?) — you understand (?) (2nd-person form, perhaps imperative; parse uncertain; printed with a different vowel from ወትለቡ)
glossary.ትብሉኑ: ብህለ — do you say? (2mp imperfect, defective b-h-l, + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.ትተረጐም: ተርጐመ — she/it is interpreted (3fs imperfect, T stem passive; agrees with ባሕር)
glossary.ትእምርተ: ትእምርት — sign, token (noun, fem., accusative) · construct 'sign of' (ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life')
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
glossary.ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነበበ: ነበበ — he spoke (3ms perfect, G, n-b-b)
glossary.ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his') · they spoke, 'were said', impersonal 3mp perfect (ነኪር ነገሩ በእንቲአኪ 'wondrous things were said about you', Psalm 87:3 as quoted, ch. 98) (?)
glossary.ነፍስ: ነፍስ — soul, person, life (noun) · 'living, alive' as predicate (እንዘ ነፍስ ኮነት 'while living it became'; ዘነፍስ 'that of life')
glossary.ንድኅን: ድኅነ — we may be saved (1cp subjunctive, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
glossary.አሚነ: አሚን — faith, belief (noun, accusative; from አምነ 'believe') (?)
glossary.አምሕሎ: አምሕሎ — oath (verbal noun of አምሐለ, used as a cognate accusative)
glossary.አቅደመ: አቅደመ — first, beforehand (3ms perfect of አቅደመ 'precede', used adverbially)
glossary.አኀዊሁ: አኅ — his brothers (noun, plural አኀው + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.አዕፅምትየ: ዐፅም — my bones (noun, plural አዕፅምት + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.አዝማዲሁ: አዝማድ — his kinsfolk (plural of ዘመድ + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ) · nominative, subject or apposition (ኀተምዋ አይሁድ 'the Jews sealed it'; ዕዉራነ ልብ አይሁድ 'the Jews, blind of heart')
glossary.አድኀነ: አድኀነ — he saved (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ)
glossary.አድኀነነ: አድኀነ — he saved us (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ, + -ነ 'us', 1cp)
glossary.አድኀኖሙ: አድኀነ — he saved them (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አጋር: አጋር — Hagar (proper name) · in ch. 112 read as 'on foot', 'foot-soldiers' (አጋር እለ ድልዋን ለፀብእ 'footmen fit for battle') (?)
glossary.አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
glossary.ኢሐመ: ሐመ — he did not suffer (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G, ḥ-m-m)
glossary.ኢትቅብረኒ: ቀበረ — you shall not bury me (ኢ- + 2ms jussive, G, q-b-r, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ኢኮንኩ: ኮነ — I am not, was not (ኢ- 'not' + 1cs perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢይመውት: ሞተ — he does not die (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ኢይምጻእ: መጽአ — he does not come (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ኢይብራህ: በርሀ — that it not shine (ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive after ከመ, G, b-r-h)
glossary.ኢይኅድጉ: ኀደገ — they shall not leave (ኢ- + 3mp jussive, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኣምሕለከ: አምሐለ — I adjure you, make you swear (1cs imperfect, causative of መሐለ, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.እሁበከ: ወሀበ — I will give you (1cs imperfect, G, w-h-b, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of') · from where (እምኀበ ኢሀሎ 'from where there was not', before a clause)
glossary.እምአይሁድ: አይሁድ — from the Jews, of the Jews (እም- 'from' + noun)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እኅወ: እኁ — brother of (noun, construct state, accusative-form; ሀገረ እኅወ እሙ 'city of his mother's brother')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ) · 'from' (?) before ቀላየ ባሕር, standing for a preposition because the relative 'which' fits poorly (እንተ ቀላየ ባሕር 'from the depths of the sea', Psalm 68:22) (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እግዚእነሂ: እግዚእ — our Lord also (noun + -ነ '1cp our' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?) · 'came to be' with a noun predicate/subject (በዕፅ ኮነ መድኀኒቱ ለአዳም 'through wood came Adam's salvation'; ኮነ ቀዳሚ ስሕተቱ 'came his first error'); ኮነት 'she became' of the rod (ወኮነት ዘነፍስ 'and it became living')
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55) · 'all those' as antecedent of the relative እለ (እምነ ኵሎሙ እለ ፈጠረ 'above (?) all those whom he created')
glossary.ወህቦሙ: ወሀበ — he gave them (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; the initial ወ is the verb's first root letter, not 'and'; ህ printed for ሀ)
glossary.ወለደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' marking the object + plural ደቂቅ + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወሕይወትየ: ሕይወት — and my life (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወመለኮቱ: መለኮት — and his divinity (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ወረሰየነ: ረሰየ — and he made us, set us as (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, r-s-y + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወርኩሰ: ርኩስ — and unclean, impure (ወ- + adjective, accusative)
glossary.ወቀበርዋ: ቀበረ — and they buried her (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, q-b-r, + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ወቀበሮ: ቀበረ — and he buried him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ወበሓውርት: ሓውርት — and by/in ሓውርት (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun, perhaps from ሖረ 'go', 'journeys' or 'regions'; sense uncertain)
glossary.ወበትረ: በትር — and rod of (ወ- + noun, construct) · and staff (ወ- + noun, accusative; ሕልቀተ ወበትረ 'ring and staff')
glossary.ወበኀበ: ኀበ — and before, with (ወ- + በ- + ኀበ) · and among (ወበኀበ አብዳንሰ 'and among fools') · and at the place where (ወበኀበ ኀደሩሰ 'and where they dwelt'; ch. 53)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበዝንቱኬ: ዝንቱ — and by this indeed (ወ- + በ- 'by' + demonstrative + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.ወበይእቲ: ይእቲ — and through that, through her (ወ- + በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative)
glossary.ወብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — and his wife (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወተሦዐ: ተሦዐ — and he was sacrificed, offered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ሠዋዐ 'sacrifice', contracted (?))
glossary.ወተረግዘ: ተረግዘ (?) — and he was pierced, struck (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive; root rare, sense guessed from context)
glossary.ወተቀነወ: ተቀነወ — and he was nailed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive of ቀነወ)
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተአስረ: ተአሰረ — and he was bound (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of አሰረ 'bind')
glossary.ወተወድየ: ተወድየ — and he was put (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ወደየ 'put, place')
glossary.ወትለቡ: ለበወ (?) — and you understand (ወ- + 2nd-person subjunctive (a 2ms of ለበወ would end -ው, so the form is uncertain); ለበወ 'understand' (?))
glossary.ወትጠይቅ: ጠየቀ — and you examine closely (ወ- + 2ms subjunctive, G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ወኀረየ: ኀረየ — and he chose (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ወኀተምዋ: ኀተመ — and they sealed it (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḫ-t-m, + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ወኀተምዎ: ኀተመ — and they sealed him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወኀፍሩ: ኀፈረ — and they were ashamed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḫ-f-r)
glossary.ወአሕዛብ: ሕዝብ — and nations, peoples (ወ- + plural አሕዛብ)
glossary.ወአምላከ: አምላክ — and God of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአምላኪየ: አምላክ — and of my God (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወአምሐሎሙ: አምሐለ — and he made them swear, adjured them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ- stem of መሐለ, m-ḥ-l; + -ሙ 'them', joined by -o-)
glossary.ወአኀዊሁ: እኁ — and his brothers (ወ- + plural አኀው, አኀዊ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወአእመኑ: አእመነ (?) — and they caused belief, or they believed (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect; the a- suggests the causative of አምነ 'believe')
glossary.ወአእሚሮ: አእመረ — and knowing, having come to know (ወ- + converb of አእመረ 'know')
glossary.ወአጥረየ: አጥረየ (?) — and he gained, acquired (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect; perhaps from ጥሪት 'property, wealth')
glossary.ወአጥረየነ: አጥረየ (?) — and he gained us, acquired us as his own (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ነ '1cp us'; see ወአጥረየ)
glossary.ወኢይጻእ: ወጽአ — and he does not go out (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወእግዚእነ: እግዚእ — and our Lord (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወከሠተ: ከሠተ — and he opened, uncovered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, k-ś-t)
glossary.ወካዕበ: ካዕበ — and again (ወ- + adverb) · 'and also, moreover' where it adds a further item (ወካዕበ ተቀብረ በህየ 'and he too was buried there', ch. 112)
glossary.ወክርስቶስኒ: ክርስቶስ — and Christ too (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
glossary.ወወረደ: ወረደ — and he/it descended (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, w-r-d)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውሉዲ: ውሉድ — and his children (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, plural + -ሁ '3ms his'; the printed ውሉዲ for ውሉዱ) (?)
glossary.ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዝኒ: ዝ — and this also (ወ- + demonstrative ዝ 'this' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወደምሩ: ደመረ — and gather up! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, G, d-m-r)
glossary.ወደቅ: ደቂቅ — and children, little ones (ወ- + collective, short form of ደቂቅ) (?)
glossary.ወዳንኤልኒ: ዳንኤል — and Daniel too (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወገብአ: ገብአ — and he returned (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወጾሮ: ጾረ — and he carried him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-r, + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዑቅኬ: ዐቀበ (?) — take heed, then (imperative? the form is irregular (?), + -ኬ 'then')
glossary.ዕቅደኒ: ዐቀደ (?) — bind me (2ms imperative, G, ʿ-q-d, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዕንቡዛን: ዕንቡዝ (?) — youths, tender young men (?) (plural -ዛን of ዕንቡዝ) · in ch. 112, in a row of insults (አብዳን ሕቡላን ፅሩፋን ዕውራን ዕንቡዛን 'fools, corrupt, foul, blind, ...'), read 'dull' from the series (?)
glossary.ዕውራን: ዕዉር — blind (adjective, plural ዕዉራን, used as a noun; construct 'of blind')
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
glossary.ዘመዲ: ዘመድ — his kin, kinsman (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his'; Bezold's spelling, as ወልዲ)
glossary.ዘበትንሣኤ: ትንሣኤ — which is in the resurrection (ዘ- relative + በ- 'in' + noun)
glossary.ዘበአበዊሁ: አብ — which was held by his fathers (ዘ- + በ- 'by' + plural አበው, አበዊ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘአምሐሎ: አምሐለ — which he made him swear (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of መሐለ, + -ሎ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘአርአዩ: አርአየ — that which they showed (ዘ- relative 'that which' + 3mp perfect, causative a-stem of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame') · 'except' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ሐሰት 'except falsehood')
glossary.ዘወረደ: ወረደ — which came down (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘየኀትሙ: ኀተመ — that they were sealing (ዘ- as conjunction (?) + 3mp imperfect, G, ḫ-t-m)
glossary.ዛህገር: ሀገር — this land (ዛ 'this' + ሀገር 'land, country', printed as one word; source slip)
glossary.ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ያስተጋብእ: አስተጋብአ — he gathers (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, አስተጋብአ, the causative of ተጋብአ 'assemble')
glossary.ያብርህ: አብርሀ — that it shine (3ms subjunctive after ከመ, ʾa-stem causative of በርሀ 'be bright', b-r-h) · 'that he give light' (ከመ ያብርህ ለነ 'that he give light to us', ch. 112)
glossary.ያዕቆብሰ: ያዕቆብ — as for Jacob (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for, however')
glossary.ይሁቦሙ: ወሀበ — he gives them (3ms imperfect ይሁብ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይሁዳ: ይሁዳ — Judah (proper name) · Judas, the betrayer (በእንተ ይሁዳ ድልው ሊተ ዐስብየ 'concerning Judas, my wage is ready'; heading of ch. 108)
glossary.ይመስሎሙ: መሰለ — it seems to them (3ms imperfect, G, m-s-l, + -ሎሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ይሬዒ: ርዕየ — he pastures, tends (3ms imperfect, G, r-ʿ-y)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይብልዕዎ: በልዐ — they devour him (3mp jussive/imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — let him arise (3ms jussive, Gt, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ይኅበር: ኀበረ — that he be joined, share (3ms jussive, G, ḫ-b-r)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct) · Egypt as goal of a journey, accusative without a preposition (ርደተ አብርሃም ግብጽ 'descent of Abraham to Egypt') · the Egyptians (ርእይዎሙ ግብጽ 'the Egyptians saw them')
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ጸውዖሙ: ጸውዐ — he called them (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-ʿ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ፅሩፋን: ጽሩፍ — foul, defiled (adjective, plural ጽሩፋን; printed ፅ-)
glossary.ፈለ: ፈለሰ — first half of ፈለሰ 'he migrated', split by a stray wordspace (ፈለ ፡ ሰ); not a separate word
glossary.ፈለሰ: ፈለሰ — he migrated, journeyed (3ms perfect, G, f-l-s)
glossary.ፈርሀ: ፈርሀ — he feared, stood in awe of (3ms perfect, G, f-r-h)
glossary.፪: ፪ — 2, spoken ክልኤቱ (kəlʾetu) 'two'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'two' (ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods')
glossary.፲ወ፪ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — twelve sons (printed without a space: ፲ወ፪, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ ʿäśärtu wä-kəlʾetu 'twelve' + ደቂቀ, accusative plural of ወልድ 'son')
glossary.፷፼: ፷፼ — spoken ስሳ ትእልፊት (sǝsa tǝʾǝlfit) 'sixty ten-thousands', i.e. 600,000 (numeral; ፼ = 10,000); the spoken words are a reconstruction, unchecked (ትእልፊት 'myriad' (?); the Geʿez Bible may instead say 'six hundred thousand' (?))
glossary.፻፲፪: ፻፲፪ — spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-kəlʾetu) 'one hundred and twelve'; chapter number (numeral)
